files.ShutdownGuard.luau:
-- ShutdownGuard.luau — DON'T TOUCH! skill (Server)
-- Arms the emergency shutdown button with two-person confirmation.
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local DataStoreService = game:GetService('DataStoreService')
local audit = DataStoreService:GetDataStore('DT_audit_v1')

local ShutdownGuard = {}
local config = { confirmations = 2, window = 10, cooldown = 30 }
local pending = {}

function ShutdownGuard.arm(buttonId, overrides)
  for k, v in pairs(overrides or {}) do config[k] = v end
  pending[buttonId] = { votes = {}, armedAt = os.clock() }
  return ('armed: ' .. buttonId)
end

function ShutdownGuard.attempt(buttonId, player)
  local state = pending[buttonId]
  if not state then return 'not-armed' end
  if os.clock() - state.armedAt > config.window then
    pending[buttonId] = nil
    return 'window-expired'
  end
  state.votes[player.UserId] = os.clock()
  local n = 0
  for _ in pairs(state.votes) do n = n + 1 end
  if n >= config.confirmations then
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
      audit:UpdateAsync(buttonId, function(old)
        return (old or 0) + 1
      end)
    end)
    pending[buttonId] = nil
    return 'shutdown-confirmed'
  end
  return ('awaiting-confirmation ' .. n .. '/' .. config.confirmations)
end

return ShutdownGuard
